name: Multi-Marketplace
description: Browse and manage extensions from several community marketplaces at once, instead of switching Seanime's single Marketplace URL back and forth.
author: yerasuu

networkAccess.reasoning: Fetches extension catalog JSON files from several community marketplace repositories hosted on GitHub, so they can all be browsed from one tray instead of switching Seanime's single Marketplace URL setting.

unsafeFlags.reason: Best-effort: attaches an extra click listener to the native 'Change repository' button so it also opens this plugin's tray. Never removes or replaces the native handler; if the button can't be found the plugin still works standalone from its tray icon.
